description: Guard (016 FR-007). A multi-line HTML comment block holds one backtick on its first line and two on its closing line, then a later paragraph quotes '<!--' in a span of its own. A renderer ends the block at its '-->' whatever backticks it holds, and per-line reading agrees, so both markers are harvested. A fix that pairs across the block would pair the first-line backtick with the first closing-line one, leave the second unpaired, pair it into the later paragraph, and so leave that paragraph's '<!--' armed: the second marker would vanish.
